channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: British forces recruitment rises as intake overtakes outflow
item.description: UK Armed Forces recruitment has overtaken personnel outflow for the first time in almost four years, with recruitment rising 13%. The post British forces recruitment rises as intake overtakes outflow first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Healey avoids date for Defence Investment Plan
item.description: The Defence Secretary avoided confirming whether the Defence Investment Plan will be published before Parliament rises for the Christmas recess during defence questions in the House of Commons. The post Healey avoids date for Defence Investment Plan first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britain to buy thousands of drones and vows faster rollout
item.description: The Ministry of Defence says it is accelerating the development and adoption of uncrewed systems, while acknowledging that regulation remains a major barrier. The post Britain to buy thousands of drones and vows faster rollout first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Labour MP opposes defence spending rise in Commons clash
item.description: The government has defended increased defence spending after a Commons exchange in which a Labour backbencher argued that poverty and inequality pose a greater threat to life in the UK than external military dangers. The post Labour MP opposes defence spending rise in Commons clash first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK a ‘sitting duck’to missile attack, MP warns
item.description: The UK lacks adequate defences against advanced missile threats and is exposed to attack as a result, according to comments made in the House of Commons during Defence questions. The post UK a ‘sitting duck’to missile attack, MP warns first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK commits £140m to counter Russian drone threat
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has announced a rapid £140 million investment in drone and counter-drone technology through the newly formed UK Defence Innovation. The post UK commits £140m to counter Russian drone threat first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: US carries out more lethal strikes on alleged narco vessels
item.description: US forces carried out lethal strikes against three vessels in international waters on 15 December, killing eight men described by Washington as “narco-terrorists”, as the Trump administration continues its expanding maritime campaign in the Caribbean. The post US carries out more lethal strikes on alleged narco vessels first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britain is ‘under sustained attack’ from foreign states
item.description: MPs warned in the Commons that hostile states are exploiting political division, trade links and digital networks to undermine the UK, as Liberal Democrat MP James MacCleary said foreign interference now threatens Britain’s security, economy and democratic institutions. The post Britain is ‘under sustained attack’ from foreign states first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Ajax woes loom over UK Defence Investment Plan
item.description: Parliamentary answers and Commons exchanges have highlighted continued uncertainty over the Ajax armoured vehicle programme, amid signs that unresolved issues may be contributing to delays in wider defence planning. The post Ajax woes loom over UK Defence Investment Plan first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Russian threat to UK is growing, warns defence chief
item.description: "The trend, from Russia in particular, is worsening, and that is the key argument for action", warned Air Chief Marshal Sir Richard Knighton. The post Russian threat to UK is growing, warns defence chief first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
